answer: The price of trying is 70 stamped dockets, each costing $83 to have checked, paid up front for every single name, while the velvet stays small. The desk only stamps a name that carries Reedbound thatch trimmer straw licence, and the stamp itself rests on a licence thatch trimmers carry after thatch room audits. The ledger counts names, not wishes, and every name on it has paid its own way. Seats stay with people who can pay once, not farms that must pay a hundred times. The tally keeps signal. The clerk notes cipher.
